title: session list refuses with no sessions after a migration whose sessions were all archived
symptom: After migrating a 0.5.0 project whose sessions are all finished, chough session list exits 1 'no sessions; run chough session new <key>', though .chough/archive/sessions/ holds the migrated stories
trigger: Migrate a 0.5.x project with no open session, then chough session list
expected: Every record is readable by session list after the migration (REQ-records-009); archived stories are listed
environment: local-macos-arm64, tester clone at 367dc86b, debug build, SpecSync 6.2.0
impact: A migrated project cannot list its history until a new session is made

notes.text: status: open -> investigating. Red at 0ee296aa (leif/0.6.0-test1-red: d854ce1a plus the regression tests): TC-history-session-list-reads-stories-alone failed for this bug's reason; fix in 4936b629.
